# Walks of Italy

> > Walks of Italy offers expertly guided small-group and private tours across Italy's most iconic destinations, including Rome, Florence, Venice, Vatican City, Milan, and Pompeii.

Specializing in skip-the-line access to world-renowned attractions like the Colosseum, Uffizi Gallery, Vatican Museums, and St. Mark's Basilica, Walks of Italy provides immersive cultural experiences led by art historians and local experts. The company also offers authentic food tours, cooking classes, and exclusive after-hours access to Italy's treasures.

## Key Topics

- Small-group guided tours
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Private tours with expert guides
- Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
- Colosseum & Roman Forum
- St. Mark's Basilica
- Uffizi Gallery
- Michelangelo's David
- Italian food tours & cooking classes
- Gondola rides in Venice
- Art historian guides
- After-hours exclusive access
- Grand Canal tours
- Tuscan cuisine experiences
- Rome, Florence, Venice, Milan destinations

- [Colosseum Arena Floor & Roman Forum Express Tour](https://www.walksofitaly.com/rome-tours/colosseum-arena-express-tour): Express 2-hour tour of Colosseum Arena Floor & Roman Forum in Rome

- [Borghese Gallery Tour & Pre-Reserved Tickets](https://www.walksofitaly.com/rome-tours/villa-borghese-gallery-tour): Borghese Gallery art tour featuring Caravaggio & Bernini with tickets
- [Private Early Morning Vatican Tour](https://www.walksofitaly.com/vatican-tours/private-early-morning-vatican-tour): Private early morning Vatican tour before crowds arrive
- [Colosseum Tours in Rome](https://www.walksofitaly.com/rome-tours/attraction/colosseum-tours): Colosseum guided tours with guaranteed tickets & Roman Forum access
